description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_FarmingBot"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FarmingBot">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PlayerBot" name="Player and farming bot" processRef="Process_FarmingBot"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SelectedFriends" name="Selected friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Brag" name="Brag about completion" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendMaterials" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Participant_SelectedFriends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FarmingPreferences" name="Begin farming setup">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_SelectResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetPriorities" name="Set resource priorities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SetPriorities</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfigureDependencies" name="Configure tool and resource dependencies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dependencies_Farming</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dependencies_Farming</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Farming_SelectFriends</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Farming" name="Start farming">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FarmingStart_Farm</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FarmResources" name="Farm selected resources (up to 10 in parallel)"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Farming" name="Farming finished">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farm_FarmingEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FarmingStart_Farm" sourceRef="StartEvent_Farming" targetRef="Task_FarmResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farm_FarmingEnd" sourceRef="Task_FarmResources" targetRef="EndEvent_Farming"/>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_NaturalDisaster" name="Handle natural disaster" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Random natural disaster occurs" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DisasterStart_Setback</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_NaturalDisaster">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">natural disaster occurs</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_SetBackBot" name="Set bot back due to natural disaster">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DisasterStart_Setback</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NaturalDisaster" name="Setback applied">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DisasterStart_Setback" sourceRef="StartEvent_NaturalDisaster" targetRef="Task_SetBackBot"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Setback_DisasterEnd" sourceRef="Task_SetBackBot" targetRef="EndEvent_NaturalDisaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Milestone" name="Notify on milestone" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Milestone" name="Milestone reached" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_Milestone">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farming milestone reached</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Milestone" name="Player notified">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MilestoneStart_Notify" sourceRef="StartEvent_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_MilestoneEnd" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="EndEvent_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>

      <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_UpdateList" name="Update farming list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_UpdateList">
            <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">farming list update requested</bpmn:condition>
          </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:userTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_UpdateList" name="Farming list updated">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateStart_UpdateList" sourceRef="StartEvent_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateList_UpdateEnd" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="EndEvent_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectFriends" name="Select friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Farming_SelectFriends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectFriends_ShareSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareSplit" name="Choose how to share">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectFriends_ShareSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShareSplit_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShareSplit_SendMaterials</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShareSplit_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag_ShareJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShareSplit_SendMaterials</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMaterials_ShareJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShareJoin" name="Sharing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag_ShareJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMaterials_ShareJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShareJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Process" name="Sharing complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShareJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_SelectResources" sourceRef="StartEvent_FarmingPreferences" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SetPriorities" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetPriorities"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Priorities_ConfigureDependencies" sourceRef="Task_SetPriorities" targetRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dependencies_Farming" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureDependencies" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Farming_SelectFriends" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Task_SelectFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectFriends_ShareSplit" sourceRef="Task_SelectFriends" targetRef="Gateway_ShareSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShareSplit_Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_Brag">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">brag to selected friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShareSplit_SendMaterials" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareSplit" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">send materials to selected friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag_ShareJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMaterials_ShareJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_ShareJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShareJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ShareJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_Process"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
